summary: Site 322 has one piezo counter with one record per slot. The data is clean apart from two real outages: 1-11 Oct 2022 at this counter only, and 20 Oct 2025, when the whole feed was down (every nearby site reads 0). zero_outage handled both correctly, apart from four stray single counts in Oct 2022, which are now set to missing. The other zero_outage fixes (Jul 2022, Jun 2024, Aug 2025) fell on wet days when nearby counters dropped by the same proportion, so the raw values are restored; one counter with no shared sites means no series needs defining.
